articles.title: Monteoro Minerals fully funded for 15,000-metre Colombian gold and copper drill programme in 2027
articles.summary: Monteoro Minerals CEO Bob Neill joined Steve Darling from Proactive to discuss the company's extensive gold and copper exploration portfolio in Colombia, its fully financed 15,000-metre drilling programme planned for 2027, and the discovery potential across its key projects in the Antioquia Department. Neill explained that Monteoro Minerals was established in 2020 by former members of AngloGold Ashanti's Colombian grassroots exploration team. Following a 2025 merger with the former Bullet Group portfolio, the company gained access to a district-scale land package across Antioquia, Colombia, encompassing six principal exploration opportunities. The company is now focusing on three core projects, La Ruana, Nudillales and La Marquesa with drilling expected to begin at two leading prospects in January and February 2027. One of the more advanced projects has a history of approximately 12,000 metres of drilling, including intercepts of 400 metres at 1.3 grams per tonne gold equivalent and more than 300 metres at 1.6 grams per tonne gold equivalent. Monteoro plans to return to the prospect with a new drilling campaign in February. Neill also highlighted an undrilled copper, silver, gold and molybdenum prospect featuring a 1,400-metre-by-400-metre geochemical anomaly and two breccia centres. Surface sampling has returned encouraging copper and gold grades, and the company plans to use initial drilling to investigate the potential mineralisation at depth. Interest in the undrilled prospect has already come from three major mining companies but Monteoro intends to complete its initial drilling before considering potential partnership arrangements. Looking beyond its immediate drilling priorities, the company plans to continue evaluating its primary and secondary projects while assessing potential joint ventures and additional acquisition opportunities. Neill confirmed that the company has the financial resources in place to advance its planned exploration programme. "We're fully financed for our 15,000 meter drill program next year," he said. The CEO added that Monteoro expects to begin reporting exploration results during the first half of 2027, as it works to advance its Colombian portfolio and assess the potential for new discoveries. #proactiveinvestors #monteorominerals #tsxv #MTAU #mining #Gold #Copper #Colombia #GoldExploration #CopperExploration #Mining #MineralExploration #Antioquia #Drilling
